name: Pineapple Express
source:
When a friend finds themselves in a difficult situation and asks for help, MC without hesitation lends him his support. But what if this help could impact his relationship with beloved? He has only one small opportunity to control the situation and avoid awkwardness, by using the codeword "Pineapple Express."

[From F95Zone]
translation:
当朋友遇到困难寻求帮助时，MC会毫不犹豫地给予支持。但如果这种帮助会影响他与心爱之人的关系呢？他只有一次小小的机会来控制局势并避免尴尬，那就是使用暗号“菠萝快车”。

[来自F95Zone]
